entries.title: Beltline mixed-use mid-rise
entries.changes: Running-bond brick joints, roof membrane laps, HVAC louvres and contained terrace planting.
entries.extension_contract: Fixed native building, 34.16 × 34.16 m envelope; larger plot retains the unscaled building. No floor multiplication or stretching.

visual_review.scope: Complete offline delivered-GLB visual evidence; native architectural-clay concept standard. No runtime, terrain, resizing, publication, engineering or textured-keeper approval.
pixel_findings: All 13 final full-resolution renders inspected individually plus locked front/oblique/top source board and both phone boards.

Five-storey brick-and-dark-metal identity, corner glazed bays, central vertical bays, inset upper storey and projecting roof-plan shoulders remain consistent with the locked archetype at architectural-clay concept scope.

Running-bond head joints survive quad optimization, read cleanly on both visible facade orientations and remain subordinate at whole-building scale. No evident flicker, displaced detail or opaque overlays on glazing in the offline evidence.
Roof membrane laps stay shallow; skylight curbs, penthouse wall ribs and louvered roof units remain visibly seated and legible.
Corner terrace planting fits inside existing planters without blocking perimeter walking space. Guardrails and recessed balconies have visible floor and wall support.
Windows retain recess and occupied-room depth; complete elevations and roof are present. Whole-building cameras preserve grade-to-roof margin.
limitations: Unseen elevations and interior layouts are authored inferences; exact surveyed reproduction is not claimed.
Rooftop plant and clay finishes remain simplified relative to photographed equipment and surface weathering.
Small trim joints and seam terminations remain non-blocking construction polish under the classroom concept standard.
Runtime renderer behavior of fine facade detail and model loading performance have not been tested by this review.

Recessed windows expose occupied room depth. Furnished ground floor, continuous stairs, guarded upper opening and enclosed bedroom partitions remain visibly intact.

limitations: Unseen rear and interior arrangement remain authored inferences, not surveyed source facts.
